content.scopeOfRegistration:
The scope of the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification is limited to the information security management system (ISMS) supporting the design, development, deployment, and operation of Anthropic's AI services and products and in accordance with the statement of applicability, version 1.4, dated July 31, 2025.  The in-scope products and services include the following:
In Scope Products and Services:
•    Claude Development Platform
•    Claude for Work (Team and Enterprise)
•    Claude Code
•    AI Research & Development activities supporting the above services

The scope of the ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification is limited to the artificial intelligence management system (AIMS) supporting the development and provision of AI services and products, in the role of AI Producer and AI Provider, and in accordance with the statement of applicability, version 1.4, dated July 31, 2025.  The in-scope products and services include the following:
In Scope AI Products and Services:
•    Claude large language models and their deployments through
o    Claude Development Platform
o    Claude for Work
o    Claude Code
•    AI Research & Development activities supporting the above services
